snippet.title: Yume Nikki Fangame playthrough - Yume Tsuduri ver. 0.02
snippet.description:
Content warning:
- Eyestrain
- Jumpscares, loud noises and unsettling music
- Blood and gore
- Scenes that may trigger scopophobia and trypophobia

Read more about this fangame: https://ynfg.yume.wiki/Yume_Tsuduri_(%E3%82%86%E3%82%81%E3%81%A4%E3%81%A5%E3%82%8A)_
Download (self-extracting executable file): https://ux.getuploader.com/yumetsuduri/download/6

TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 Starting the game
2:52 Getting Skateboard BELONGING
4:20 Exploring Shadowy Sunset Town
5:21 Getting Lyre and Konpeitou BELONGINGS
9:25 Getting Stilts BELONGING (I got lost for a while lol sorry)
13:28 Getting Blank BELONGING, Exploring some more worlds
20:16 Getting Dice BELONGING, messing with the Slot Machine
23:47 Getting Boiling Water BELONGING (EYESTRAIN WARNING)
27:28 Exploring a rainy brick path, Seeing a toy block tower aurora outlook
31:52 Getting Tuxedo BELONGING
32:43 Getting Paint BELONGING, Turning Text Events ON, Trying on Menu Types
38:06 Exploring the Text Events Nexus (first 3 doors)
40:11 Reading all the books in the 4th Text Event Nexus door
45:44 Finding another connection to an already explored world
46:38 Seeing Jail Hallway EVENT (JUMPSCARE WARNING)
